第59章 破封2-《城隍是我老祖，原来我是神N代》

话音刚落，恶鬼猛地一挥手，刚刚出手的云川，就像被一辆大卡车撞上一般，直直的向后倒飞而去，重重摔在地上，嘴角瞬间溢出鲜血。

“桀桀桀，吃了你们两个，本座再去找茅山的那帮牛鼻子算账。”

吴姜暗骂一声，此刻就是拼命的时候了，大不了就按老祖宗说的，去当那专职的阴差去。

不再犹豫，吴姜直接盘腿坐在地上，双眼紧闭，下一秒，一道黑色的魂体从他体内飘出，腰缠锁魂链，手握斩魂剑，头上的帽子，写着一个大大的“差”字。

正准备扑向云川道士的恶鬼，猛地转头看向吴姜。

吴姜不由自主得咽了一口唾沫，虽说已经决定拼命了，但他还是准备好了随时打开阴阳通道，一有危险，就跑进去。

恶鬼动作顿住，狰狞的脸上露出一丝挣扎，收拾眼前两个蝼蚁轻而易举，但是吴姜的身份让他忌惮。

他现在并非全盛时期，这时候招惹地府，不是明智的选择。

最后，猛鬼深深看了吴姜一眼，没有丝毫犹豫，转身就朝着后方的深山密林飞去，黑色的身影瞬间就消失在了漆黑的树林里，只留下一缕淡淡的黑气，证明它曾经出现过。

吴姜见状，这才松了口气，连忙收回魂体，快步走到云川的身边，伸手将他扶起：“云川，你怎么样？”

云川靠在吴姜身上，脸色苍白如纸，嘴角溢出一丝血迹，呼吸也有些急促，摇了摇头，声音沙哑地说道：“我没事，还能坚持的住。”

吴姜扶着他，慢慢走到路边的石阶上坐下。

云川从随身带的布袋子里，掏出一个小巧的药瓶，倒出一颗丹药吞了下去。

丹药刚一入腹，云川苍白的脸色就好了一些。

“吴姜，多谢你了，要不是你，今天我就交代在这了。”

吴姜摆了摆手，“客气什么，我也没帮到什么忙，还让那家伙跑了。”

云川此刻恨不得扇自己两个嘴巴子，当时要是听吴姜的建议多好，现在不要说功德了，不加业力都是好的了。

吴姜拍了拍他的肩膀，安慰道：“好了，事已至此，再多的懊悔也没用。接下来，你准备怎么办？”

此事是云川主导的，自然还是以云川的意见为主。

As soon as he finished speaking, the evil spirit waved his hand violently. Yunchuan, who had just taken action, flew backwards as if he had been hit by a large truck, and fell heavily to the ground, with blood instantly flowing out of the corner of his mouth.

"Jie, Jie, Jie, if I eat you two, I will go and settle the score with those Niubi guys in Maoshan."

Wu Jiang cursed secretly, now is the time to fight desperately. At worst, he will follow the instructions of his ancestors and become a full-time undercover agent.

Without any further hesitation, Wu Jiang sat cross-legged on the ground with his eyes closed tightly. The next second, a black soul floated out of his body, with a soul-locking chain wrapped around his waist, a soul-killing sword in his hand, and a big "bad" character written on the hat on his head.

The evil ghost who was about to pounce on Taoist Priest Yunchuan suddenly turned his head to look at Wu Jiang.

Wu Jiang swallowed involuntarily. Although he had decided to fight for his life, he was still ready to open the Yin and Yang channel at any time and run in if there was danger.

The evil ghost paused, and a trace of struggle showed on his ferocious face. It was easy to deal with the two ants in front of him, but Wu Jiang's identity made him afraid.

He is not in his prime now, and it would not be a wise choice to provoke the underworld at this time.

Finally, the fierce ghost took a deep look at Wu Jiang, without any hesitation, turned around and flew towards the deep mountains and forests behind. The black figure disappeared in the dark woods in an instant, leaving only a faint wisp of black air, proving that it had appeared before.

When Wu Jiang saw this, he breathed a sigh of relief, quickly took back his soul body, walked quickly to Yunchuan, stretched out his hand to help him up: "Yunchuan, how are you?"

Yun Chuan leaned against Wu Jiang, his face as pale as paper, a trace of blood spilled from the corner of his mouth, and his breathing was somewhat rapid. He shook his head and said in a hoarse voice: "I'm fine, I can still hold on."

Wu Jiang supported him and slowly walked to the stone steps by the roadside and sat down.

Yun Chuan took out a small medicine bottle from the cloth bag he carried with him, poured out a pill and swallowed it.

As soon as the elixir entered his stomach, Yun Chuan's pale face became better.

"Wu Jiang, thank you very much. If it weren't for you, I would have told you here today."

Wu Jiang waved his hand, "You're welcome, I didn't help much, and I even let that guy run away."

Yun Chuan wanted to slap himself in the mouth at this moment. It would have been better if he had listened to Wu Jiang's advice at that time. Now, let alone merit and karma, it would be good.

Wu Jiang patted his shoulder and comforted him: "Okay, that's it. It's useless to regret more. What are you going to do next?"

This matter was led by Yunchuan, and naturally Yunchuan's opinion was the main one.
